name: arun279-plugins
description: Claude Code plugins published by Arun Krishnamurthy, starting with codex-delegate for one-call blocking Codex jobs.

plugins.name: codex-delegate
plugins.description: Runs one OpenAI Codex CLI job from Claude Code through a blocking foreground launcher that validates the live model pair, owns the process group and deadline, reads the JSON terminal event, cleans up on completion or stop, and returns reduced status. Prompts and files Codex reads are sent to OpenAI. Broad PreToolUse hooks inspect Bash, Monitor, and Workflow call text; the PermissionRequest hook is inert. Requires macOS, Python 3, and a signed-in Codex CLI.
